Data: EmoV-DB (Adigwe et al., 2018), four English speakers: bea and jenie (female), sam and josh (male); five emotions. Features and vocoder: WavLM-Large layer 6 and the HiFi-GAN of kNN-VC (Baas et al., 2023). Every clip on this page, the real recordings included, goes through the same vocoder, so differences come from the model.
